messages:
TEAM~AQUA~GRUNT sent out Pelipper
and Ferrothorn!

The opposing Pelipper flinched
and couldn’t move!

A tailwind started blowing
on the~opposing side!

Charizard has Mega Evolved
into Mega Charizard!

It’s not very effective on
the opposing Pelipper.

It’s extremely effective on
the opposing Ferrothorn!

The opposing Ludicolo
lost some of its HP!
